_doc: THE SHARED AI CONTRACT of the fleet (libs:ai). Every app that chats with a model reads this one file: the Kotlin apps through libs:ai's AiConfig (Cloud Search, Cloud Browser, Cloud Drive, Cloud Tools Small LLMs), Cloud Code (JS) through tools/resolve-targets.py, which copies the gateway and OpenRouter blocks into targets.gen.json. Nobody restates an endpoint, a path or a header name: nav.json::chat no longer carries gateway or direct. The agents themselves (identity, X-Agent-Mode, capabilities) stay in libs:model-catalogue assets/agents/agents.json, the list both families already read; test/chat.mjs holds the two files to the same chat path and mode header. The wire shapes and their cases are in protocol-cases.json, run by libs:ai's AiProtocolTest and by Cloud Code's test/chat.mjs.
label: AI

gateway._doc: my-ai-api (service cloud-agi-goose, WireGuard-only): one OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions that picks the agent with the X-Agent-Mode header (hermes | openclaw | deepseek | goose | claude-cli | openrouter). GET /health lists the live modes and plugins; /v1/mcp/status, /v1/mcp/search?q= and /sessions are its MCP servers, tools and cross-device sessions; /v1/models its model list. No token leaves the phone for it: the gateway holds the fleet key. Verified against cloud-u-containers user-ai_my-ai-api/src/code/server.mjs on 2026-10-10.

openrouter._doc: OpenRouter itself (OpenAI-compatible chat completions), with the token from the fleet Account (read by the app per send, never stored by the lib) or, in Cloud Code, the plugin's encrypted one. The live model list is models_url; a model whose supported_parameters list native_web_param searches the web natively, any other searches through the `web_plugin` plugin when Web is on. Verified against the live catalogue on 2026-10-02.
openrouter.label: OpenRouter

protocol._doc: stream: ask for server-sent events when the app's HTTP client can hand over chunks (a client that cannot gets the whole answer). history_turns: the last N messages go with a request. max_tool_rounds: a send with tool plugins stops after this many model calls. title_chars: a session's title is its first message cut to this.
